title: DPP data point
description: A data point that a legal act requires, allows or expects in a digital product passport. Data points are reference material for criteria; they are not checked themselves.

regime.description: Legal act that defines the data point.

tier.description: How firmly the legal act fixes the data point. ESPR: fixed, minimum, conditional, delegated-act, annex-i, voluntary. Product-specific acts: regime. Law outside DPP rules: sectoral.

term.description: Term used in the English version of the legal act.

en18223_attribute.description: Attribute of the class DigitalProductPassport (EN 18223:2026, Table 1) that carries the value, if any.

granularity.description: Level the value refers to (model, batch, item, product type, substance, ...).

access.description: public: the legal act puts the value in the public part, or requires it on the product or via the data carrier without access restriction. restricted: the legal act limits it to named actors. delegated-act: left to the delegated or implementing act. unspecified: the legal act says nothing about access.
